messages.snippet: Alistair, Confirming completion of Cygnet House this afternoon. We've sent the balance of £19,020,08
messages.subject: Cygnet House - completion
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Confirming completion of Cygnet House this afternoon. We've sent the balance of £19,020,080.97; thank you for confirming receipt and for releasing the TR1, the leases and the executed rent deposit deed assignments. We hold your undertaking to forward the DS1 / evidence of discharge of the Clydesford charge. We'll serve notices of assignment on the tenants and the managing agent and attend to the SDLT return and HMLR registration.

A pleasure working with you.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate — Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
DDI +44 (0)20 7946 0531

messages.snippet: Daniel, With completion done, a quick post-completion note: the SDLT return has been filed and £1,07
messages.subject: Project Mosaic - completed; SDLT and registration
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

With completion done, a quick post-completion note: the SDLT return has been filed and £1,077,000 paid today (within the 14-day deadline); our application to register the transfer at HM Land Registry is being submitted under our OS1 priority. We're holding the £25,000 service charge retention pending the 2025 reconciliation. Notices of assignment have gone to all eight tenants and the managing agent.

We'll send our completion statement and bill shortly. Congratulations on the acquisition.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate — Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
